about: Page images made for the hand-import tests by table-pages.py, not taken from the Library of Congress. The text is NCI's "Down Home Healthy Cooking" (NIH Publication No. 06-3408, U.S. government text, public domain; the same pages as nci-pages.json), set in the layout of the Library's old cookbooks: a title, an ingredient table with dot leaders and the amount at the right, the method in prose. The last page keeps only the whole-number rows of NCI's seasoning (its fractional rows left out), so a table every row of which can be read is on a page. expected holds the ingredient lines the rule reader gives each recipe, amount first.

recipes.title: BLACK SKILLET BEEF.
method: Partially freeze beef. Thinly slice across the grain into long strips, one-eighth inch thick.
Spray a large, heavy skillet with non-stick spray coating. Preheat pan over high heat. Add meat; cook, stirring for 5 minutes.
Add potatoes, onion, broth, and garlic. Cook, covered, over medium heat for 20 minutes. Stir in carrots and cook, covered, until carrots are tender (about 15 minutes).

recipes.title: BAKED FRIED CHICKEN.
method: Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees. Spray a medium baking pan with cooking spray. On waxed paper, mix bread crumbs, cheese and cornmeal.
In pie plate, beat egg white and salt. Dip each piece of chicken in egg white mixture, then coat with bread crumb mixture. Place chicken in pan.
Bake chicken for 30 minutes or until coating is crisp. Add mixed vegetables to chicken. Bake for 5 more minutes.

recipes.title: BAKED PORK CHOPS.
method: Trim all fat from chops. Beat egg white with evaporated skim milk. Place chops in milk mixture; let stand for 5 minutes, turning chops once.
Meanwhile, mix together cornflake crumbs, bread crumbs and salt. Remove chops from milk mixture. Coat thoroughly with crumb mixture.
Place chops in pan; bake in 375 degree oven for 20 minutes. Turn chops; bake 15 minutes longer or until no pink remains.
